scope.decision_stage: authorization of one bounded development pilot, not submission readiness
scope.canonical_method: TempoRAC: Identity-Indexed Local Tempo Routing for Multi-Person Repetition Counting
canonical_properties: one pose encoder shared by every supplied identity
fast, medium, and slow learned response experts shared across identities
temporal state and reconstruction buffers private to each identity
masked source-clock-aware tempo evidence estimated independently in overlapping local windows
soft expert routing and response fusion before discrete counting
exactly one decoder invocation per complete identity and no summation of independent window counts
excluded_substitutes: per-person copies of a complete model

allowed_now: implement unit tests for the seven canonical invariants
run the frozen synthetic primitive-orbit topology and harmonic kill gate
build and audit the physical feature/label separation
verdict.allowed_after_k0_through_k6: one three-seed GT-bbox-assisted AlphaPose supplied-track development pilot
verdict.failure_disposition: REJECT the canonical method; do not substitute WARP-PHASE or a backup pivot without a new review
verdict.rationale: The exact conjunction is weakly distinguishable and highly falsifiable, but the supplied response objective does not identify one physical repetition. A primitive-orbit left-inverse gauge can conditionally fix the response unit while preserving all seven properties. That assumption must pass synthetic topology, harmonic, shortcut, and teacher-redundancy gates before any natural-data pilot.

scores.scale: 1-10, higher is stronger; scores apply to the supplied pre-contract proposal

feasibility.reason: A bounded implementation is possible, but no current tree implements it and the PAMS path lacks the required COCO-17, multi-identity, and source-clock graph.

icassp_fit.reason: Local time-frequency evidence, response-rate reconstruction, and overlap-add fit signal processing if the paper remains narrow and mechanism-led.

failure_symmetries: zero or constant response when reconstruction bypasses the response
positive response-scale exchange with a learned decoder
integer phase winding and half/double/higher-harmonic solutions
human annotation conventions not determined by observable pose
identifiability.reason: Paired monotone-warp consistency, routing consistency, response consistency, and unconstrained motion reconstruction do not define one response unit as one physical repetition.
identifiability.conditional_assumption: Valid clock-blind pose delay states form a primitive S1 orbit with trivial rotational stabilizer for one annotated repetition.
identifiability.conditional_theorem: If a memoryless phase map f from the primitive orbit to S1 has a continuous left inverse G because G composed with f is the identity, then f is injective and has degree plus or minus one. Non-negative temporal orientation fixes degree plus one. Integer harmonics are not injective and subharmonics are not single-valued continuous maps on the primitive circle.
identifiability.limitation: Approximate reconstruction and real action semantics do not guarantee the theorem's assumptions. Alternating limbs, self-intersections, interruptions, noise, and annotation conventions may violate them.
identifiability.failure_consequence: Reject the no-human-count/period response route. The minimum extra information would be a boundary pair, period, or count convention, which violates the canonical supervision constraint.

input_clock.pose: COCO-17 root-relative, scale-normalized coordinates, confidence, bones, signed differences, joint masks, and frame masks
input_clock.valid_edge: both endpoints valid and positive source-frame delta

phase_teacher.role: training-only response-unit gauge, not an inference substitute or paper contribution
phase_teacher.input: memoryless clock-blind local delay state and one static per-track content vector
forbidden_inputs: human count, period, boundary, or density
phase_teacher.decoder_input: phase on S1 plus the static content vector only; no residual or time bypass
phase_teacher.loss: L_teacher = L_inv + lambda_v L_view + lambda_o L_orient + lambda_a L_alias
phase_teacher.left_inverse_loss: joint-mask-normalized Huber reconstruction of the delay state
phase_teacher.view_loss: one minus phase-vector dot product at exact paired monotone-warp correspondences
phase_teacher.orientation_loss: ReLU of negative signed circular increments
phase_teacher.alias_loss: ReLU of absolute signed increment minus 0.25 cycles per valid edge
phase_teacher.weights_selected_from: frozen synthetic primitive-orbit suite before natural development labels

shared_encoder.pams_tcc: optional initialization only; inferred SSHead excluded; initialization must be ablated

tempo_evidence.signal: root-relative pose/delay features without full-track contextual leakage
operators: Hann-weighted non-uniform DFT on source-frame clocks
tempo_evidence.retained: full normalized ACF and spectral distributions
tempo_evidence.fusion: normalized geometric mean on a common frequency grid
tempo_evidence.confidence: valid-pair coverage times ACF/FFT Bhattacharyya agreement times one minus normalized entropy

router.reason_for_fixed_router: prevents the router from ignoring the claimed tempo evidence and keeps the first pilot causal

experts_and_state.pilot_architecture: two-block causal depthwise-separable TCN, width 64, kernel 5
experts_and_state.output: non-negative edge rate in cycles per source frame via softplus
experts_and_state.state_policy: advance once over each full identity; cache left context per identity and expert; windows read outputs and never recommit overlapping samples

response_and_reconstruction.fusion: window response is the soft gate-weighted sum of expert edge-rate responses

decoder.formula: sum over valid unique edges of reconstructed_rate times positive source-frame delta

student_loss.track_term: source-duration-weighted Huber between reconstructed full-track response and teacher rate
student_loss.head_term: taper-, gate-, mask-, and source-duration-weighted Huber between each expert response and teacher rate

gradient_contract: Optional PAMS-TCC stage updates only the shared encoder and is initialization evidence only.
Teacher loss updates only the memoryless phase map, delay-state decoder, and static-content encoder.
Teacher parameters and hash are frozen before TempoRAC training.
TempoRAC loss updates the shared encoder, three shared experts, and identity-private state projections through response fusion and NOLA.
TempoRAC loss cannot update the teacher, tempo distributions, track reference, router, taper, clocks, masks, window starts, identity keys, or decoder.
No evaluator target, count-based early stopping, calibration, or label-derived checkpoint selection is permitted.
A fresh graph is built per full-identity batch; state is not detached at window boundaries and never persists across optimizer steps.

mandatory_controls: one response head matched to the total expert parameter and FLOP budget
hard local routing using the same cue
soft track-global routing with every other component unchanged
window-local routing with cue blocked to neutral and shuffled within track
independent window decode and sum versus positive NOLA then one decode
stateless, shared-scene, identity-private, reset-at-window, and shuffled-identity-key state variants
PAMS and Track-PAMS on identical supplied tracks
PAMS-TCC initialization versus identical training without it
RepNet only in a genuinely input- and protocol-matched block; MultiCounter, MultiCounter+, HTRM-Net, and TWCRAC contextual otherwise

kill_gates.name: firewall_protocol
kill_gates.criteria: Feature-only shards, separately permissioned label vault, forbidden-key scan, exact hashes, zero train/dev canonical-source overlap, and no test/sealed/heldout/result path reachable.
kill_gates.failure_action: stop before any data-bearing training or pilot; pure contract and synthetic unit work may continue

kill_gates.name: topology_identifiability
kill_gates.criteria: On frozen synthetic primitive S1 orbits and unseen resamplers: at least 95% degree +1; at most 5% combined half/double/higher-harmonic lock; at most 1% negative edges; at most 1% latent collisions; at most 2% count-mass error; reconstruction below the frozen left-inverse tolerance.
kill_gates.failure_action: reject the count/period-annotation-free response route without tuning on natural counts

kill_gates.name: seven_invariants
kill_gates.criteria: Shared parameter identities, private state/buffer keys, outside-window cue isolation, simplex soft gates, fusion before decode, positive finite NOLA coverage, and decoder calls equal complete identity count.

kill_gates.name: shortcut_resistance
kill_gates.criteria: No-pose, timestamp/position-only, warp-metadata, track-length/confidence-only, and matched-time pose-shuffle controls retain less than 10% of canonical gain; unseen interpolation preserves at least 80%.
kill_gates.failure_action: reject as clock, augmentation, or metadata shortcut

kill_gates.name: expert_mechanism
kill_gates.criteria: Each expert receives at least 10% effective mass on the balanced synthetic tempo suite and beats the capacity-matched one-head model in its assigned unseen-resampler region with paired interval above zero; cue shuffling removes at least 80% of local-over-global gain.

kill_gates.name: reconstruction_ordering
kill_gates.criteria: Shifted-grid count mass changes by at most 0.5%; positive NOLA reduces boundary duplicate or miss error versus independent window decoding; padding and duplicate clocks contribute exactly zero.

kill_gates.name: identity_isolation
kill_gates.criteria: A one-person tempo intervention with all other track bytes fixed changes untouched state, response, and count by at most 1e-6 in deterministic evaluation; shuffled keys cause the preregistered failure.
kill_gates.failure_action: implementation failure and no private-state claim

kill_gates.name: pilot_efficacy
kill_gates.criteria: At least 5% relative video-first AvgMAE reduction versus the strongest matched nonlocal/control model under frozen piecewise drift, paired source-component bootstrap lower bound above zero, clean stationary AvgMAE upper bound no worse than +0.02, and three independent seeds.
kill_gates.failure_action: kill canonical method; no backup substitution

kill_gates.name: closest_prior_and_teacher
kill_gates.criteria: TempoRAC exceeds teacher-only inference, one-head, Track-PAMS/PAMS, and every matched closest prior beyond uncertainty.

kill_gates.name: literature_and_title_closure
kill_gates.criteria: Complete TWCRAC inspected with no equivalent contribution and title/acronym collision check passed.

protocol.permitted_name: GT-bbox-assisted AlphaPose supplied-track partial-cache development pilot
protocol.primary_endpoint: paired source-component change in video-first AvgMAE under frozen piecewise within-track tempo drift
secondary_metrics: supplied-track Period-mAP/AP50/AP75 only when the temporal evaluator contract is satisfied
protocol.uncertainty: paired canonical-source-component bootstrap 95% intervals plus sample standard deviation across full runs
forbidden_interpretations: direct ranking against native MultiCounter or MultiCounter+ values
protocol.power_warning: The 51-video, 9-component development cache may be underpowered. An inconclusive interval fails advancement rather than weakening the gate.

claim_boundary.maximum_if_all_gates_pass: We study whether identity-indexed, window-local soft tempo routing among shared pose-response experts improves supplied-track multi-person repetition counting under within-track tempo drift, using a counting objective that reads no human per-person count or period annotations, with response fusion and positive normalized overlap-add before one fixed per-track decode.
